432	def _ballot_ids(ballot_file: str | Path, grammar: str) -> list[str]:
   433	    ids: list[str] = []
   434	    seen: set[str] = set()
   435	    if grammar == "finding-oos":
   436	        pattern = re.compile(r"^(?:###\s+)?((?:FINDING|OOS)_[0-9]+):")
   437	    else:
   438	        pattern = re.compile(r"^(?:###\s+)?(FINDING_[0-9]+):")
   439	    try:
   440	        lines = Path(ballot_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
   441	    except OSError:
   442	        return []
   443	    for line in lines:
   444	        match = pattern.match(line)
   445	        if match and match.group(1) not in seen:
   446	            seen.add(match.group(1))
   447	            ids.append(match.group(1))
   448	    return ids

   168	  REPORT="$TMPDIR_SLICES/report"

   170	  ROLLUP_DECL_ERRORS="$TMPDIR_SLICES/rollup-decl-errors"

   172	  : > "$MISSING_SLICE_RULES"
   173	  : > "$ROLLUP_DECL_ERRORS"

   176	  local continuation_violations="$TMPDIR_SLICES/continuation-violations"
   177	  local individual="$TMPDIR_SLICES/individual"
   178	  local slice_all="$TMPDIR_SLICES/slice-all"
   179	  local slice_no_self="$TMPDIR_SLICES/slice-no-self"
   180	  local duplicates="$TMPDIR_SLICES/duplicates"
   181	  local missing="$TMPDIR_SLICES/missing"

   183	  local th_prereqs="$TMPDIR_SLICES/th-prereqs-actual"
   184	  local th_prereqs_expected="$TMPDIR_SLICES/th-prereqs-expected"
   185	  local th_prereqs_missing="$TMPDIR_SLICES/th-prereqs-missing"
   186	  local th_prereqs_extra="$TMPDIR_SLICES/th-prereqs-extra"

   221	  extract_test_harnesses_prereqs "$makefile" "$th_prereqs"

   231	  # .PHONY membership check (R2_F9): every shard-bound test-* target must

   233	  # lines; we union all tokens after the first colon. Continuation lines
   234	  # ending with backslash are folded onto the prior line.

   236	    BEGIN { in_phony = 0; buf = "" }
   237	    {
   238	      line = $0
   239	      # Continuation handling: if previous line ended with `\`, append.

   241	        line = line " " next_line
   242	      }

   244	        sub(/^\.PHONY:[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
   245	        n = split(line, parts, /[[:space:]]+/)
   246	        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
   247	          if (parts[i] != "") print parts[i]
   248	        }
   249	      }
   250	    }

   257	  # shard-6).

   271	  append_section "test-harnesses aggregate has unexpected prerequisites" "+" "$th_prereqs_extra"
